As Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Stock Price Rose, Shareholder Northeast Financial Consultants Boosted Its Position; As Disney Walt Co Com (DIS) Valuation Declined, Roundview Capital Decreased by $583,899 Its Stake
May 21, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Roundview Capital Llc decreased its stake in Disney Walt Co Com (DIS) by 8.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roundview Capital Llc sold 5,457 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.57% with the market. The institutional investor held 58,956 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.34 million, down from 64,413 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roundview Capital Llc who had been investing in Disney Walt Co Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $154.91B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.39% or $0.41 during the last trading session, reaching $103.93. About 5.43M shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has declined 11.59% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.14% the S&P500.
Northeast Financial Consultants Inc increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 109.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northeast Financial Consultants Inc bought 3,016 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 5,771 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.02M, up from 2,755 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northeast Financial Consultants Inc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $501.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $195. About 14.24M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Northeast Financial Consultants Inc, which manages about $2.86 billion and $300.91M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) by 4,000 shares to 1,500 shares, valued at $284,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing.

After $1.84 actual EPS reported by The Walt Disney Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 7.61% EPS growth.
